source.title: Species composition, distribution, biomass trends and exploitation of dominant fish species in Manila Bay using experimental trawl survey

studyAreaMap.decision: Map is visual context only. Do not digitize station points, trawl tracks, or use the figure as a boundary without source coordinates and validation.

tableReview.scope: Top 50 fish and invertebrate taxa by biomass abundance, grouped by province.
tableReview.commonnessMarks: Haul-frequency bands: 30-50%, 20-30%, 5-20%, and less than 5% of hauls; these are not individual fish counts.
tableReview.decision: Retain as a historical, province-grouped source summary only. Do not reinterpret as species-by-station, municipal-water, complete, or current-presence data.

rightsReview.currentPolicySummary: Current submission policy says authors submitting manuscripts agree to CC BY-NC 4.0 and retain article copyright; it also says permission is needed for previously published tables and figures.
rightsReview.decision: Do not infer the current policy is the license for this 2017 item. Obtain item-specific rights-holder confirmation before transcribing or publishing Table 3.2.

permissionAndDataRequestDraft.subject: Rights clarification and station-data inquiry: 2017 Manila Bay trawl survey
permissionAndDataRequestDraft.body: Hello NFRDI Library, I am preparing Bangwit, an independent Philippines-focused fishing and aquatic-species reference project. Could you confirm whether the 2017 Manila Bay trawl paper has an item-specific reuse license, and whether written permission is required to transcribe its Table 3.2 into a noncommercial, attributed reference dataset? Could NFRDI or BFAR share any underlying station coordinates or trawl-track data for the 16 stations, including CRS/datum, survey dates, source documentation, and reuse terms? We will not reproduce the paper's map or figures. Please advise the required attribution, scope, and conditions. Thank you, Joseph Lopez.

limits: This is a 2014-2015 experimental trawl survey, not a current inventory or fishing advisory.
The 146 reported fish-and-invertebrate species and province-group totals are not fish-only or municipality-level checklists.
No single station coordinate, station-specific species record, or municipal-water boundary is adopted from Figure 3.1.
No email, login, payment, permission request, or publication action was performed.
